lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing the shadows where the city lights start to fade
Counting the debts and the promises that I haven't paid
Walking a wire between the silence and the city noise
Finding the rhythm in the heavy balance of the poise
Iron in my blood and a vision in my head
Walking through the ghosts of the words that went unsaid
Every step is a mountain, every breath is a choice
Finding the melody in the echo of my inner voice
[Chorus]
Deep in the current, I’m finding my way
Turning the midnight into the light of the day
Weight on my shoulders, but fire in my soul
Steady and moving, making fragments whole
[Verse]
Building a kingdom from the stones they threw at me
Chasing the truth in a world of what they see
The clock is ticking like a hammer on the glass
Watching the seasons and the heavy moments pass
I’m diving deep where the pressure meets the bone
Carving my name into the granite of the unknown
No more running from the shadows in the hall
Standing tall enough to catch the wind before the fall
[Chorus]
Deep in the current, I’m finding my way
Turning the midnight into the light of the day
Weight on my shoulders, but fire in my soul
Steady and moving, making fragments whole
[Bridge]
The surface is calling, but I’m going deep
Keeping the promises that I intended to keep
[Chorus]
Deep in the current, I’m finding my way
Turning the midnight into the light of the day
Weight on my shoulders, but fire in my soul
Steady and moving, making fragments whole
[Outro]
